title: Drop and Asset
author: Cyrus Marchetti
blurb: Jude Vasquez, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
